entries.title: Jeremiah 18:1
segments: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:2
segments: Arise and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause you to hear My words.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:3
segments: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he was working a work on the wheel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:4
segments: And the vessel that he made in clay was ruined in the hand of the potter; so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make [it].

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:5
segments: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:6
segments: O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter? says the LORD. Behold, As the clay in the potter's hands, [so are] you in My hand, O house of Israel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:7
segments: The instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck it up and to pull it down, and to destroy [it];

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:8
segments: if that nation, against whom I have spoken, will turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:9
segments: And the instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build it and to plant [it];

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:10
segments: if it does evil in My sight, not to obey My voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would do them good.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:11
segments: Now then please, speak to the men of Judah, and to the people of Jerusalem, saying, So says the LORD: Behold, I am forming evil against you, and devising a plan against you. Return now, each one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:12
segments: And they said, There is no hope; but we will walk after our own ways, and we will each one do [according to] the stubbornness of his evil heart.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:13
segments: Therefore so says the LORD, Ask now among the nations; who has heard the like of this? The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:14
segments: Does the snow of Lebanon forsake the rock of the field? [Or] shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:15
segments: Because My people have forgotten Me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused themselves to stumble in their ways [from] the old paths, to walk [in] by-paths, not [in] the highway,

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:16
segments: to make their land desolate [and] a hissing forever. Everyone who passes by will be amazed, and will wag his head.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:17
segments: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:18
segments: Then they said, Come and let us plot schemes against Jeremiah. For the law shall not perish from the priest, nor wisdom from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:19
segments: Pay attention to me; O LORD, and attend to the voice of my foes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:20
segments: Should evil be repaid for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before You to do good for them, [and] to turn away Your wrath from them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:21
segments: Therefore deliver up their sons to the famine, and give them over to the hand of the sword. And let their wives be bereaved, and widows, and their men [be] slain of death; let their young men be struck by the sword in battle.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:22
segments: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when You suddenly bring a raiding party on them. For they have dug a pit to take me, and have hidden snares for my feet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 18:23
segments: Yet, LORD, You know all their counsel against me to kill [me]. Do not forgive their iniquity, nor blot out their sin from Your sight, but let them be overthrown before You; deal with them in the time of Your anger.
